mapper.select: SELECT e.expense_id AS expenseId, e.title AS title, e.amount AS amount, m.name as payerName, CASE WHEN e.payer_id = #{memberId} THEN true ELSE false END AS isMyPayment, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM expense_shares es WHERE es.expense_id = e.expense_id ) AS targetMemberCount FROM expenses e INNER JOIN members m on e.payer_id = m.member_id WHERE e.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY e.expense_id DESC

SELECT e.expense_id AS expenseId, e.title, e.amount, e.currency, e.fx_rate AS fxRate, e.spent_at AS spentAt, e.payer_id AS payerId, m.name AS payerName, m.bank_name AS bankName, m.account_number AS accountNumber, CASE WHEN e.payer_id = #{memberId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isMyPayment FROM expenses e JOIN members m ON e.payer_id = m.member_id WHERE e.expense_id = #{expenseId} AND e.room_id = #{roomId}

SELECT es.member_id AS memberId, m.name, es.amount AS shareAmount, CASE WHEN es.member_id = #{memberId} THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS isSelf FROM expense_shares es JOIN members m ON es.member_id = m.member_id WHERE es.expense_id = #{expenseId} AND m.room_id = #{roomId} ORDER BY es.member_id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expenses( room_id, payer_id, title, amount, currency, fx_rate, spent_at ) VALUES ( #{roomId}, #{payerId}, #{title}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{fxRate}, #{spentAt} )
